purpose: TASK-052: prove findSkuRefsInTransaction reads only this Supplier's rows on the caller's transaction. The PO Line foreign key has one column, so the database cannot catch a wrong Supplier's ref, and a fake cannot prove the SQL.
data: No-DB case: fake rows only. MySQL case: 3 items, 3 SKUs, 2 Suppliers, 3 committed relations, 1 relation inserted inside the transaction. Inputs include duplicates, an empty list, 100 IDs and 101 IDs on the fake.
concurrency: 1 connection and 1 transaction in the MySQL case's own reads and write; serial within the existing shard. No two-connection trial.
thresholds: Exact equality on the returned Map; TypeError on invalid input; no locking clause in the SQL. No performance threshold.
trigger: Routine functional server tests through existing discovery. One natural CI run on one push. No new job, schedule, dispatch or retry. No capacity: audit-17 and audit-18 are only statically related and are not selected on a PR.
cost: Estimated under 1 second for the no-DB case and a few seconds for the MySQL case; not measured. No new job; effect on the CI critical path expected to be negligible, not measured.
